translations.web: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
translations.bsb: Without wood, a fire goes out; without gossip, a conflict ceases.
translations.kjv: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
translations.asv: For lack of wood the fire goeth out; And where there is no whisperer, contention ceaseth.
